description: UNC2529 is a financially driven cyber‑criminal organization that routinely deploys large‑scale spearphishing campaigns and fileless malware to penetrate and profit from a broad spectrum of industries, including defense, finance, media, government, healthcare, manufacturing, IT, aerospace, energy, and education. Their most notable operation – the "Triple Double" campaign in late 2020 – leveraged more than 50 domains and introduced a sophisticated three‑stage payload series (DOUBLEDRAG JavaScript downloader, DOUBLEDROP PowerShell dropper, DOUBLEBACK backdoor). The group combines social engineering with zero‑day‑style persistence techniques to exfiltrate data, execute ransomware, and facilitate BEC operations.
goals: The actor’s strategic objective is purely monetary: it exploits compromised data, ransomware, business email compromise (BEC), pig‑butchering, and cryptocurrency assets. Their targeting spreads across critical and commercial sectors—defense, finance, media, government, healthcare, manufacturing, IT, aerospace, energy, education—in the United States, South Africa, and Australia. A hallmark of UNC2529 is its use of legitimate domains and digital certificates to lend credibility to phishing content, allowing it to bypass email security controls easily and deliver file‑less payloads that evade traditional endpoint protection without writing malicious binaries to disk.
